criteria: Each implemented collectible needs actual native collision/collection and at least one meaningful use/effect; passive benefits are distinct from attack projectiles.
Natural block reveal/RNG permutations, every facing/animation, all water/caps/exhaustion/lifecycles are additional quality coverage, not automatic prerequisites for each-powerup-at-least-once.
Source-qualified, prepared-unrun or failed profiles never become a native pass. Historical native results retain their own ROM/mode; source equality never silently retags them current.
Shared Mushroom/Flower/Star/1Up are separate from family-local items and from enemy-copy powers.

Robots.scope: Both identities: earned mushroom/Charge, all7 weapons, RushCoil bounce/use12, Balance/refill; RushJet absent.

Samus.scope: Nine real mature item/refill collections, actual Morph/bomb boost, missile cost/refill, Ice freeze, Wave terrain, Varia powered tier/crouch, Screw contact; Long auto-item. Plus native HUD jump.

Bass.scope: Both modes: all9 mature items0..8, paid weapons/actual damage/cleanup and Balance/refill.

Pit.scope: Both modes: mushroom/flower tiers, hammer all tiers, actual60-fuel flight/recharge/refusal.

Rygar.scope: Both modes: real mushroom/flower transforms; six earned disk40/64/88 throws, real enemy contact/retraction/catch.

TMNT.scope: Four identities, each15 cases: earned food and all4 gear, exact paid volleys/contacts/cleanup, replacement/refills, genuine damage/heal.

Mac.scope: Mushroom heals real deficits, flowers grant punch-stars; paid uppercuts both facings, empty refusal, stamina recovery.

Mike.scope: All13 private reward IDs81..8D: primary tiers,10 earned specials, actual costs/contacts/refills, Mirror reflection, Asterisk split, health benefits.

ChipDale.scope: Both variants: actual damage, mushroom+1/flower fullHP, natural crate/lift/hide/throw/defeat, physical1Up retains HP/status/held crate.

CV3.scope: All3 Hard: real deficits/heal,1/5 heart drops,1Up conservation; Grant dagger/axe/watch180/climb, Sypha3spells, Alucard2/3bolts/bat.

BillLance.scope: Both native7 legal gun/Rapid cases with staged mature physical grants, actual use/contact/cadence/cleanup. Initial mushroom form seeded, so no mushroom acquisition credit.

Scrooge.scope: Physical mushroom/flower0->1->2 and source pogo ground rebounds/enemy defeats; tiers do not grant a different cane.
